note: Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/ua-portable-vectors.mjs (src/ua.js, @noble/curves 2.4.0, @noble/post-quantum 0.7.1); never edit by hand. UA-8 portable registrations as typed EIP-712 records (typed-signing TS-D1 ... TS-D4): domain EIP712Domain(string name,string version) = ("SCaaS UA Portable", "1"), no chain id, verifying contract or salt (typed.*); typed(s) = keccak256(0x1901 | typed.domainSeparator | hashStruct(s)); no chain and no registry anywhere. KEM keys (CTR-UA-32): kemPk = scheme byte | key; kemScheme 1 = ML-KEM-1024 + X25519, 0x01 | ek (1,568 B) | X25519 pk (32 B) = kemPkLength bytes; scheme 2 (ML-KEM-1024 + HQC + X25519) is reserved and refused (UAKemScheme), as is every other scheme byte; an empty key or a key of another length than its scheme's is UAKemKeyLength. Digests: pqzKeyHash = keccak256(PQZ_KEY_GROUP | pqzKey) (keyHash of scheme 0x0142, not a plain keccak; the key is of a set's length, else UAKeyData); pqzPopHash = keccak256(pqzPop); kemRecordHash = hashStruct(UAKemRecord{ua, version, scheme = kemPk[0], kemPkHash = keccak256(kemPk)}) of the initial record, the zero record UAKemRecord{ua, 0, 0, 0} when there is none (version 0 is never a valid record); portableRecordDigest = typed(UAPortableRecord{ua, kind, pqzKeyHash, kem}) (kind = the registering kind, uint16); registrationDigest = typed(UARegistration{record, pqzPopHash = attrs.pqzPopHash}); popMessage = ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_POP_V2, registrationDigest); pqzRegMessage = ua_msg(0x0142, PURPOSE_POP_V2, portableRecordDigest) (the R_REG message); kemRecords: structHash = hashStruct(UAKemRecord), digest = typed(UAKemRecord), signed as ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_KEM, digest); PQZ key record (setPqzKey): pqzKeyDigest = typed(UAPqzKey{ua, pqzKeyHash}) (its R_REG message: ua_msg(0x0142, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, pqzKeyDigest)), recordDigest = typed(UAPqzKeyRecord{UAPqzKey{ua, pqzKeyHash}, pqzPopHash}), signed as ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, recordDigest). typedData = the eth_signTypedData_v4 JSON of the signed record (hashTypedData(typedData) = registrationDigest / digest / recordDigest). Absent attributes are empty / 0. PQZ key: set once per chain, by register or later by setPqzKey(ua, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig), which is accepted only while the registration has no PQZ key (UAPqzKeySet otherwise; holder rules as register). Client rule: one PQZ key per UA, ever (a UA that signs records for two PQZ keys can end with different keys on different chains). msig: a derived member signs memberDigest = keccak256(ua | message) of the portable message (popMessage, the KEM record message, the PQZ key record message) under member, with empty key data for stored kinds. A code-less native EOA member (its own key only) signs the record's typed digest itself, typedDigest = registrationDigest / digest / recordDigest (what eth_signTypedData_v4 of typedData returns), 65-byte r | s | v, low-s, v in {27, 28}, empty key data; EIP-191 personal_sign is refused (native-member-personal-sign). Only for PURPOSE_POP_V2, PURPOSE_KEM and PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY; every other purpose stays UAAuth (chain-bound EIP-712: CTR-MTX-14). A contract member answers ERC-1271 isValidSignature(typedDigest, sig) on each chain: portable only where that wallet exists with the same behaviour. Rows: registrations[i] = register(kind, keyData, attrs, pop, pqzPop); kemRecords[i] = setKemKey(ua, version, kemPk, sig) (id = name/vN; v1 is also the registration's initial record); pqzKeyRecords[i] = setPqzKey(ua, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig) for a UA registered without a PQZ key (its proof bytes for storePqzPop: the set's filler, registrations "mldsa65/<set>".pqzPop). pqzPop rows are filler of a real R_REG proof's length per set, not proofs. negatives: mutation.row names a row of registrations (entry register, storePqzPop, requireAuthorized), kemRecords by id (setKemKey) or pqzKeyRecords (setPqzKey); mutation.set replaces fields (attrs.<field>, pqzPop, pop, ua, sig, pqzPopHash, purposeTag, digest, auth); mutation.registerWith gives the register call that precedes a storePqzPop row; mutation.otherKind (record-kind-mismatch) is the kind the pop's record names instead of the row's. Attribute checks run before the PoP; error is the registry's. A proof hash of keccak256("") (an empty proof) is UAPqzPopHash wherever a proof hash is signed, and storePqzPop refuses empty proof bytes.
